FieldSet.description: ALF-RS-10 (LFRDN-340). Fields AF_DocumentConditionEvaluator may reference when evaluating AF_DocumentCondition__mdt rows scoped to Opportunity via AF_DynamicObject__mdt, for Sales Order required documents. The initial condition is unconditional ("true") - no AF_Document__mdt rows exist yet since the BRD does not name specific Sales Order documents. AF_Brand__c is included so a future branch (e.g. BMW/JLR-specific requirements) can be added without a field-set/deploy change.
FieldSet.label: AF SO Document Condition Fields
